records.title: Emergent Individuality in Whole-Brain Connectome Simulations of Drosophila melanogaster (claude-fly)

decisions.notes: Pinned README and linked Zenodo paper are accessible and describe a two-simulated-fly system. The pinned HEAD commit adds a third-party LLM-driven variant; scientific outputs were not independently reproduced. DOI resolves, but the repository snapshot and paper must not be treated as two replications. No human pain, ECAP or SCS outcome.

searches.service: Pinned GitHub README and commit API

updates.ограничения: The pinned README describes the same-author Rojas Aliaga FlyWire/NeuroMechFly simulation and cites a resolving Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19152238; reported outputs were not independently reproduced. The pinned repository commit is by Zackery Sayers and adds a separate LLM-driven variant, so its whole tree cannot be attributed to the paper author or treated as independent replication. README and paper also disagree on simulated-versus-wall-clock time and divergent-synapse count.
